## Open the notes app
Open http://localhost:5173 and wait for the "Kane Notes" heading to be visible.

## Verify dark mode survived
Assert that the page background is still dark.

content.text:
Fixed in `target-app/src/App.tsx:29`.

**What was wrong:** `isDark` was plain component state initialized to `false`, so every reload started in light mode.

**The change:**
- `useState(readStoredTheme)` — initial state reads `kane-notes-theme` from `localStorage` on mount.
- The existing theme effect now also writes the current value back to `localStorage`, so toggling persists.

Both accesses are wrapped in `try/catch` so the app still renders (light, unpersisted) where storage is blocked, e.g. private mode.

Kane's browser run of `tests/darkmode_test.md` is green — dark mode survives the fresh page load.
